scenes.say: Ever wondered how search engines find meaning, not just keywords? Let’s see what makes semantic retrieval possible.

scenes.label: Embedding
scenes.sub: A vector that captures the meaning of text.
scenes.say: Embeddings are numbers that represent the meaning behind words or sentences.

scenes.title: Vector Search in Action
scenes.say: First, you embed a sentence, then store it in a database. When you query, the system finds the closest matches.
This unlocks semantic search, quick document matching, and lets language models tap into external knowledge.

scenes.question: Are embeddings just keyword counts?
scenes.right: No, embeddings capture meaning, not just counts.
scenes.say: Don’t confuse embeddings with keyword counts. They actually capture the meaning of text.
